note: Bavli: [Berakhot 14a:7](sefaria:Berakhot.14a.7) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Ashyan, the tanna in the school of Rabbi Ami”. Occupational title 'tanna' (reciter of baraitot), katal pattern like ספרא. Not used as a surname elsewhere in the paper; 'תנא דבי רבי X' (312 segs) is mostly the phrase 'the school of X taught'.
Bavli: [Gittin 52b:5](sefaria:Gittin.52b.5) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Amram the dyer”. Katal pattern (צַבָּעָא). Not in paper.
